clauses.quote: On or before August 15 of each year, the Human Resources Office will provide the Association with a listing of all new bargaining unit employees who have at that point been hired for the new year.
The listing will show the name, address, and assigned location of each employee.
On or before September 15 of each year, the Human Resources Office will provide the Association with a listing of all bargaining unit employees currently on the computer file.
The listing will show the name, address, and assigned location of each employee.

The Association shall have the right to post notices of Association matters on a bulletin board space no smaller that twelve (12) square feet established for the Association's exclusive use in each school.
The specific provisions of this Agreement, and of other negotiated items, shall supersede any policy or directive of the Board which contradicts any such provision of this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: The specific provisions of this Agreement, and of other negotiated items

clauses.quote: The provisions of this Agreement may be changed only through the written mutual consent of the Board and the Association.
All terms and conditions of employment not covered by this Agreement or by other negotiated items shall continue to be subject to the Board's direction and control.
